analysis: Examined test-only changes. SandboxStatusTests.swift head 78-100 adds a workDisks test: SandboxAddonStatus decodes a new `disks` array from add-on status JSON (path, root_volume, state, detail, free_bytes, slots); entries without a path are dropped (count 3 of 4). Status rendering shows 'Work disk: <path>...' lines, appending the add-on-supplied detail for offline disks. SandboxTestSupport.swift head 187-201 adds planStandardError and workDisks parameters to the fake installer script; strings are shell-quoted via quoted() (226-228) and only used in tests. SandboxWorkDiskTests.swift (added, 433 lines) is only visible as a truncated patch excerpt: it exercises `darkbloom sandbox setup --disk`, path absolutization (relative/.., ~), SandboxWorkDisk.Volume checks (apfs, ignoresOwnership) and a suggested `sudo diskutil enableOwnership` command. No production source was supplied, so no regression is cited. Integration questions (TB-013/T-061/A-019): (1) production SandboxWorkDisk/SandboxInstaller must pass --disk paths to install.sh as discrete argv (no shell interpolation) and whether the CLI ever executes the suggested sudo command or only prints it; (2) add-on-supplied disk path/detail strings rendered to the terminal should be sanitized of control/ANSI escapes (add-on is same-owner, separately signed, so low impact); (3) whether work disks interact with provider KV cache volume selection (T-041 CacheVolume/CacheStorage) — the disks fixture has a `cache` field, suggesting the add-on may host or share the cache volume; verify any provider-side cache-root change keeps CacheVolume.inspect/validateOpenedDirectory checks. Needs review of the production Sandbox source files.
